What learning rate should I use for LoRA?

A good starting point for LoRA is 1e-4 to 2e-4 with a short warmup and cosine decay. Full fine-tuning needs a much lower rate, around 1e-5. If the loss spikes or the model starts producing nonsense, halve the learning rate; if validation loss barely moves after a few hundred steps, try doubling it.

The fine-tuned model never stops generating. Why?

Usually the model never learned to emit the end-of-sequence token. Check that you format data with tokenizer.apply_chat_template, that the template appends the end-of-turn token after each assistant reply, and that the same template is used at inference time. Also confirm the generation config has the right eos_token_id.

Should I use the base model or the instruct model for fine-tuning?

For most company tasks start from the instruct model: it already follows instructions and the chat format, so you need less data. Use a base model only when you have a large dataset and want full control of the format, or when the instruct model's style fights the behavior you need.

what is qlora

QLoRA loads the frozen base model in 4-bit precision and trains small LoRA adapters in higher precision on top. It cuts memory use by roughly 3-4x compared with 16-bit LoRA, so a 7-8B model can be fine-tuned on a single 24GB GPU, with only a small quality cost.

How many examples do I need for SFT?

It depends on the task, but for teaching a format or a narrow skill, 500-2,000 high-quality, diverse examples usually work well. Start small, measure on a fixed eval set, then add data where error analysis shows the model is weak. Quality and diversity matter more than raw count.

Can I use customer emails for training?

Only with the right consent and policy approval. Before using them, remove or mask personal data such as names, emails like [EMAIL], and phone numbers like [PHONE], and keep a record of where the data came from and who approved it.

Why does my Vietnamese data have duplicate rows that look identical?

Vietnamese characters can be encoded in two Unicode forms (precomposed or combining accents), so strings that look the same can differ byte by byte. Normalize all text to NFC before deduplication and before training.

How should I write a dataset card?

Include: the purpose of the dataset, data sources and licenses, collection and filtering steps, the number of examples per split, the schema, known gaps and biases, PII handling, and the version and date. Keep it next to the data so it is updated whenever the dataset changes.

My agent keeps calling the same tool in a loop.

Add a maximum step budget, return clearer tool results (including errors the model can act on), and make sure the tool description says what to do when nothing is found. Read the trace: often the tool returns an empty or ambiguous result and the model retries hoping for something different.

When should I use an agent instead of a workflow?

Use a workflow when you can write the steps in advance; it is cheaper, faster and easier to test. Use an agent only when the steps depend on what the model discovers along the way, the task is valuable enough to justify the cost, and mistakes can be caught by tests or review.

How do I write a good tool description?

Write it like documentation for a new teammate: say what the tool does, when to use it and when not to, what each parameter means with an example, what it returns, and how errors look. Keep tools few and non-overlapping so the model does not have to guess between them.

What is MCP?

The Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting models to tools and data. You write a server once that exposes tools, resources and prompts, and any MCP client such as Claude Code or Claude Desktop can use it over stdio or HTTP.

How do I know if my fine-tuned model is better?

Compare the base and fine-tuned models on the same frozen, held-out eval set with the same prompts and decoding settings. Use automatic checks where possible and an LLM judge with a clear rubric for open-ended answers, and read the examples where the two models disagree.

Is LLM-as-judge reliable?

It can be, if you calibrate it: give the judge a specific rubric, ask for pairwise comparisons rather than absolute scores when possible, randomize the order of answers to avoid position bias, and check its agreement with human labels on 50-100 examples before trusting it.

What metric should I use for retrieval in RAG?

Start with recall@k: for each question, is a relevant chunk among the top k retrieved results? Measure it on a labeled set of questions before looking at answer quality, because the generator cannot use context that was never retrieved.

How do I serve my LoRA model in production?

Either merge the adapter into the base weights and serve the merged model, or serve the base model with vLLM and load the LoRA adapter at request time, which lets you host several adapters on one GPU. Put an API with authentication, timeouts and logging in front of it and measure latency and throughput under load.

Why is my model slow in production?

Check whether you are batching requests, whether the KV cache fits in GPU memory, and how long your prompts are, since prefill cost grows with prompt length. A serving engine like vLLM with continuous batching usually improves throughput many times over a naive Hugging Face generate loop.

Explain DPO in simple terms.

DPO (Direct Preference Optimization) trains the model on pairs of answers to the same prompt, one preferred and one rejected. It increases the probability of the preferred answer relative to a frozen reference model and decreases it for the rejected one, without training a separate reward model as in classic RLHF.

What LoRA rank should I pick?

Rank 8-16 is a good default for style and format tasks; use 32-64 when the task is harder or the dataset is large. Set lora_alpha to about 2x the rank as a starting point, and compare a couple of ranks on your eval set instead of guessing.

Tại sao mô hình sau khi tinh chỉnh trả lời sai định dạng JSON?

Thường do dữ liệu huấn luyện không nhất quán về định dạng hoặc chat template khi suy luận khác lúc huấn luyện. Hãy kiểm tra lại mọi ví dụ đều tuân theo cùng một JSON schema và dùng tokenizer.apply_chat_template ở cả hai giai đoạn.
